narration: Chapter one. The map.
title: THE MAP
subtitle: Chapter 1

narration: GTA Six takes place in the State of Leonida. It's Rockstar's version of Florida.
And that alone is a big deal. The last time a GTA gave us a whole state, instead of one city and its outskirts, was San Andreas, back in two thousand four.
At the heart of Leonida is Vice City.
If you're old enough, you remember it from two thousand two. Pastel suits, neon lights, and an eighties soundtrack.
But this Vice City is not a remake. It's set in the present day, and it's rebuilt from the ground up.
Glass towers. Packed highways. Crowded beaches. And a nightlife that never seems to stop.
Rockstar has officially named six regions of Leonida. Let's go through them, one by one.
First, Vice City itself. Rockstar's take on Miami.
title: VICE CITY
subtitle: REGION 1

narration: The beach strip, the downtown skyline, the clubs, and all the money moving through them.
Second, the Leonida Keys.
title: LEONIDA KEYS
subtitle: REGION 2

narration: A long chain of islands, linked by bridges that stretch out over bright blue water, just like the Florida Keys.
Boats, fishing docks, beach bars, and a lot of shady business.
Third, Grassrivers.
title: GRASSRIVERS
subtitle: REGION 3

narration: Rockstar's version of the Everglades. Wide open wetlands, tall grass, slow brown water, and alligators. Lots of alligators.
Fourth, Port Gellhorn.
title: PORT GELLHORN
subtitle: REGION 4

narration: A beach town that has seen better days. Cheap motels, empty lots, and people just trying to get by.
Fifth, Ambrosia.
title: AMBROSIA
subtitle: REGION 5

narration: A small industrial town built around a giant sugar refinery. It's working class, it's rough, and it's a long way from the glamour of Vice City.
And sixth, Mount Kalaga National Park.
title: MOUNT KALAGA
subtitle: REGION 6

narration: Up in the north of the state. Forests, rivers, trails, and the wild side of Leonida.
But this map isn't just about places. It's about people.
The first trailer is packed with clips that look like real social media posts.
People partying on the roof of a moving car. Fights in the street. An alligator wandering into a convenience store.
If you've ever seen a Florida Man headline, you'll get the joke right away.
Rockstar is clearly having fun with it, and it shows how busy and alive this world is going to feel.
Now, what is not confirmed? The exact size of the map.
title: NOT CONFIRMED
subtitle: MAP SIZE

narration: You'll see videos claiming it's twice as big as GTA Five, or three times bigger than Red Dead Redemption Two.
Rockstar has not said any of that. Until we play it, map size is a guess.

narration: Chapter two. The characters.
title: THE CHARACTERS
subtitle: Chapter 2

narration: For the first time in a modern GTA, one of the main characters is a woman.
And this time, there are two leads, telling one story together.
Let's start with Lucia Caminos.
title: Lucia Caminos
subtitle: Protagonist | Locked up protecting her family. Learned to fight from her father.

narration: She's the very first thing you see in the very first trailer. A prison jumpsuit, inside the Leonida Department of Corrections.
Rockstar says Lucia ended up behind bars trying to protect her family.
Her father taught her to fight when she was just a kid.
She's tough, she's smart, and after her time inside, she's done playing it safe.
Then there's Jason Duval.
title: Jason Duval
subtitle: Protagonist | Grew up around grifters. Ex-army. Runs jobs in the Keys.

narration: Jason grew up around grifters and crooks. He tried to leave that life behind by joining the army, but it didn't stick.
Now he lives in the Keys, doing jobs for local drug runners.
He isn't chasing power. He wants something simple. An easy life.
And then he meets Lucia. Maybe she's the best thing that ever happened to him. Maybe she's the worst.
Together, they are the heart of the game.
The trailers show them robbing stores side by side, cruising with the top down, and sinking deeper into trouble.
Rockstar says that when an easy score goes wrong, the two of them end up in the middle of a criminal conspiracy that stretches across the whole state.
Think Bonnie and Clyde, in modern day Florida.
Rockstar has also introduced the people around them.
title: THE SUPPORTING CAST

narration: Cal Hampton. Jason's friend and partner.
title: Cal Hampton
subtitle: Jason's partner | Beer, Coast Guard radio, and trusts no one.

narration: He'd rather stay home with a beer, listening in on Coast Guard radio, and he's convinced that somebody, somewhere, is always watching.
Brian Heder. An old school drug runner who has worked the Keys for decades.
title: Brian Heder
subtitle: Keys drug runner | Old school. Jason lives on one of his properties.

narration: Jason lives on one of his properties, and pays his way by doing jobs for him.
Boobie Ike. A Vice City legend.
title: Boobie Ike
subtitle: Vice City legend | Real estate, a strip club and Only Raw Records.

narration: He took money from the streets and turned it into real estate, a strip club, and a record label called Only Raw Records.
Dre'Quan Priest. He dreams of managing the next big rap act, and he's signed to Boobie's label.
title: Dre'Quan Priest
subtitle: Only Raw Records | Wants to manage the next big rap act.

narration: Old friends who went viral, and now want to turn that fame into real money.
And Raul Bautista.
title: Raul Bautista
subtitle: Bank robber | Seasoned, takes big risks, always hunting new talent.

narration: A confident, experienced bank robber who is always looking for fresh talent, and doesn't mind big risks if it means a big score.

narration: Chapter three. The cars.
title: THE CARS
subtitle: Chapter 3

narration: Leonida is built for driving, and the trailers prove it.
We see muscle cars roaring down the highway.
Exotic sports cars parked outside the clubs of Vice City.
Convertibles cruising the beach at sunset.
Lifted pickup trucks kicking up dust on back country roads.
Motorbikes weaving through traffic.
Even ordinary, everyday cars stuck in traffic jams, which makes the whole world feel real.
And the detail is on another level. Paint that reflects the neon lights.
Mud on the tires. Cars that lean and bounce on the road, the way real ones do.
But in Florida, the road is only half the story. Water is everywhere.
The trailers show speedboats racing through the Keys, jet skis skipping over the waves, and airboats flying across the swamps of Grassrivers.
As always in GTA, the brands are parodies. The cars look like the real thing, but the names are Rockstar's own jokes.
And if you've played GTA before, you'll recognize a few familiar shapes.
What's not confirmed? The full list of vehicles. How many cars are in the game.

narration: Chapter four. The police.
title: THE POLICE
subtitle: Chapter 4

narration: Crime is the whole point of GTA. So what do we actually know about the law in Leonida?
First, the story starts with the justice system. Lucia's first scene is inside a prison.
So from minute one, the police are not just the people chasing you. They're part of the story.
The trailers show Lucia and Jason holding up a convenience store, masks on, guns out.
They show high speed chases on the highway, with police cruisers right on their bumper.
Helicopters circling over the city.
And arrests shown like real news clips, and even bodycam style footage, just like what you'd see on the evening news.
The police themselves look more realistic than in any GTA before. The cruisers, the uniforms, the way officers move and react. It's a big step up from the cartoon cops of the older games.
And there's something else. In these trailers, it's not only the police who are watching. It's everyone.
People film crimes on their phones. Clips go viral. The news picks them up.
In a world like that, getting away with anything might be harder than ever.
What's not confirmed? How the wanted system works. Whether it's still stars.

narration: So we're going to stick to what the trailers actually show.
And what they show is beautiful. Golden sunsets over the Keys.
A thick, hot haze hanging over the swamps of Grassrivers.
Clear blue beach days in Vice City.
And at night, the whole city glowing in neon.
The real star here is the lighting. Light bounces off water, off car paint, off skin.
Shadows stretch out as the sun goes down. It's the most realistic lighting Rockstar has ever shown, and it changes the mood of every single scene.
